basic_info.description: 1249-1253 Jackson Street is a prime triplex with three large flats, nestled in the prestigious Nob Hill neighborhood of San Francisco, which is known for its urban vibrancy and historic charm. With extremely easy access to the city's amenities and attractions, it is just steps away from renowned dining, boutique shopping, and excellent public transportation options.     This opportunity with tremendous potential offers investors and owner-users the chance to own a valuable asset in one of the city's most sought-after neighborhoods and is perfectly positioned to leverage San Francisco's vibrant rental market, which continues to exhibit strong demand, particularly for well-located multi-family properties.
